comments.story: The Good Ol' Days of QBasic Nibbles
comments.why: Ideal visual demonstration of different sorts
comments.text: Q(uick)Basic was my first programming language, and as others mentioned NIBBLES and GORILLAS.BAS were bundled with it. It also had the ability to compile down to an executable, which was fantastic. One bundled script I don't see mentioned yet was SORTDEMO.BAS - this is still my ideal for demonstrating different sorts visually: [VIDEO]
